notes.general_comments:
Most candidates completed the paper, and a small number attempted both options for the final question.
Many candidates reached a very high standard, showing excellent communication skills in producing detailed
solutions. Calculus and algebraic handling skills were impressive in general, and the majority of candidates
showed very good knowledge across the whole syllabus.
